items.title: OpenAI forms independent mathematics advisory group
items.body: OpenAI formed an independent mathematics advisory group hosted at the Institute for Advanced Study. The group (Gowers, Hairer, Witten, Wood and others) will advise on assessing and communicating AI-generated mathematical results and on tools for research. Watch next: whether the group issues public guidance on the August–September internal model results already shared by OpenAI.

items.title: OpenAI independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
items.body: Confirmed first-party. Members include Timothy Gowers, Martin Hairer, Edward Witten, Melanie Matchett Wood; group operates independently and may publish advice.

items.title: Simon Willison on Jev decision models
items.body: Jev is an interesting variant on the usual LLM format: it still accepts text inputs, but instead of text output it returns floating point numbers corresponding to categories, yes/no questions, ratings, and associated confidence scores.

items.title: 智谱被指未经用户允许上传数据 随后致歉并开源ZCode
items.body: Z.ai / Zhipu open-sourced ZCode client (zai-org/ZCode) after community discovery of silent repo-snapshot upload to Alibaba OSS; third-party audits (CAICT, NSFocus) confirm cloud zero-data and removal of the Repo Wiki path.
